review_findings: Authoritative criteria are loaded only from an explicit caller-supplied artifact reference; current artifact bytes and SHA-256 are checked, while the caller remains responsible for Owner provenance.
Ordered criterion IDs and Unicode strings are compared directly without normalization; missing, stale, reordered, duplicated, omitted, modified, or added criteria are rejected in fidelity mode.

Regression tests include the historical CSV wording mutations as synthetic input, whitespace, punctuation, case, line endings, Unicode substitution/normalization, multiline criteria, unsafe controls, and missing/stale source behavior.

The corrected-plan regression first rejects a mutated plan, preserves its artifact bytes, then accepts a separate synthetic plan with the original criteria; it explicitly does not claim Owner authorization.
Workflow and communication references require the fidelity check before dispatch and state that a matching hash is integrity only.
limitations: No authentic Owner-approved CSV fixture was available; tests use synthetic criteria.
E1, E2, and E4 remain UNVERIFIED (HOST_CAPABILITY_MISSING) as documented separately.
Gate 3 and the CSV experiment were not run; this review does not establish an E10 Gate 3 PASS or COUNCILFLOW_FULLY_VERIFIED.
